notes: **A keyguard frame now has a groove only where the keyguard has a latch to click into it.** The frame used to have grooves along the top and bottom of the keyguard's opening whatever you chose, and grooves along both sides for any keyguard with snap-in tabs, even with "snap in tabs on left and right edges of keyguard" set to "no". Now each groove follows its latch: no latch on an edge, no groove there. A keyguard on posts has its latch on its bottom edge only, and the frame has a groove for it along the bottom of the opening. If "snap in tab on top edge of keyguard" is also set to "yes", the frame has a second groove along the top, so the keyguard can go into its frame turned 180 degrees.

**A keyguard on posts now has latches on its left and right edges whenever "snap in tabs on left and right edges of keyguard" is set to "yes"**, halfway up each side, with matching grooves in the sides of the keyguard frame. They used to appear only when your design exposed a bar along the bottom of the screen. This setting is "yes" unless you changed it, so if you made a keyguard and frame on posts, open the design again and export both once you have this version, or set it to "no" to keep them as they were.
